title: Introduction to Programming for Non-Majors
wording: None. All Computer Science students and other students wishing to prepare for 3000-level courses in Computer Science should take CS 1101/CS 1102 instead of CS 1004. This course provides sufficient background for CS 2301 Systems Programming for Non-Majors.

title: Programming for Engineers
wording: None. Computer Science majors and other students wishing to prepare for 3000-level courses in Computer Science should take CS 1101/CS 1102 instead of CS 1005. This course provides sufficient background for CS 2301 Systems Programming for Non-Majors. Undergraduate credit may not be earned for both this course and CS 1004. Undergraduate credit may not be earned for both this course and RBE 100X.

title: Introduction to Program Design

title: Accelerated Introduction to Program Design
wording: Substantial prior programming experience (including functions, recursion, and lists, as would be covered in high-school Advanced Placement Computer Science A courses, but not necessarily AP CS Principles courses).
